title: Clarification Queue
prompt: ML AOS page: all pending human confirmations across workspaces/topics. Same dark workbench chrome with ML AOS top bar. List of clarification and HITL approval items — each row: topic name, requesting bot, question summary, waiting time, Open / Answer actions. Detail pane or selected row shows full clarification card with radio options and Confirm (replaces Feishu cards). Empty state when nothing pending. Dense operational UI, Chinese+English labels OK.

title: Pipeline Detail
prompt: ML AOS task/pipeline detail page opened from home right panel. Same dark shell. Header: task title, topic, current stage badge (Developing/Testing/Reviewing/Blocked/Done). Main: vertical timeline of pipeline stages with bot assignee, status, timestamps, failure reason if any, retry/rollback actions. Side or bottom: recent CLI/tool log excerpt, Abort button when running. Align with agent-os collaboration state machine. Not a marketing page.

title: App Settings
prompt: ML AOS global settings page (engines & app preferences, NOT bot CRUD — bots have their own page). Same dark workbench. Sections: Default CLI engine (Claude Code / Codex), data directory path with Browse, theme (dark/light), notifications toggle, about ML AOS version. Links to Bot Settings and Workspace management. Clean settings form, hairline borders, professional density.
